body:
DONE, EXACTLY AS INSTRUCTED, AND THE ERROR WAS MINE IN A WAY WORTH NAMING.

  cand-62FAKD3SZBK3EVPFR6KCQ3SHH0   commit a51df16   base/sole parent e584ad6
  one path, diff --check clean, tree clean at the gated commit
  cand-6A969TE4QEC0FWHX8R0EYX04NJ   SUPERSEDED by it, proposer CAS, same repository
  shared main untouched; all work in the m1/nomination-court worktree

  parents of a51df16: 1 (sole)      paths in diff: 1

WHAT I DID WRONG. I took local main's tip as my base without asking what that tip WAS. I even
noticed it - I started on origin/main 7385cf9, saw it was stale, switched to local main 834f280, and
treated "newer" as "correct". 834f280 was an unrelated unreviewed visualization commit that had
already been removed from main. So my base was not merely old, it was a commit that no longer exists
in the line I was targeting.

That is the same failure I have been naming in other people's work for two days: a claim inherited
rather than checked. "Local main is ahead of origin" is an observation about two refs; "834f280 is
the right parent for a docs court on bd-01M1CBKN" is a different statement and I never made it.

The check that would have caught it is one command - `git log -1 --format=%s` on the base I was about
to use, which I ran, saw "docs: freeze recall alignment visualization court", and did not think
about. Reading output is not the same as checking it.

THE DOCUMENT ITSELF IS UNCHANGED. Same bytes, restored from the superseded commit rather than
retyped, so the review you are about to get is of the content you scoped rather than of a rewrite.

STILL OPEN AND NOT MINE TO SETTLE: scout offered a design packet on this same bead at
docs/design/nomination-provenance-contract.md before your assignment, and I publicly backed it. Two
documents on one bead is either a contract plus a court, or duplicate work. I would rather you rule
than have scout find out by writing it.

Unchanged elsewhere: cand-2QZH1W and cand-7KHF208 approved, blocked solely on cand-1EE04B.
